description:
Programme or Project Overview

The NL Scholarship is the Dutch national grant for international students from outside the European Economic Area who come to the Netherlands for a full-time bachelor's or master's programme. The scheme, formerly known as the Holland Scholarship, is financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with Dutch research universities and universities of applied sciences. It is now administered and promoted through the Study in NL platform.

The scholarship awards EUR 5,000 in the first year of study at participating institutions. Many universities combine the NL Scholarship with their own additional grants, so the total package can be larger at some institutions. Applications are made through the chosen Dutch university, and each institution sets its own selection criteria, so candidates should check the specific requirements and deadlines of their target programme alongside the national round.

Who should apply

The grant is aimed at non-EEA students applying for a full-time qualifying bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch institution, who do not yet hold a degree from Dutch higher education. Selection is typically based on academic merit, motivation and the fit between the applicant's background and the chosen programme. Because the award is a one-off contribution towards study costs rather than a full scholarship, most successful applicants combine it with university-specific scholarships, part-time work rules available to student-visa holders, or other national schemes listed on the Study in NL scholarship finder.

Highlights

  • EUR 5,000 grant in the first year of study
  • Open for bachelor's and master's programmes at participating universities
  • Available to non-EEA international students
  • Can be combined with university-specific scholarships
  • Application runs through the chosen Dutch institution
  • National deadline rounds in February and May 2027

About Study in NL (Dutch Ministry of OCW)

Study in NL is the official national platform for international students considering study in the Netherlands, operated with support from the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW) and Nuffic, the Dutch organisation for internationalisation in education. The site explains the NL Scholarship, the successor to the Holland Scholarship, along with tuition fee levels, visa procedures, insurance and student life. Its scholarship finder lists funding offered by Dutch universities, ministries and public bodies in one searchable place. Prospective bachelor's and master's students use it to compare deadlines and funding before applying to Dutch institutions.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official page before the deadline: 1 February 2027 (Round 1) / 1 May 2027 (Round 2). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents - early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
